findings.rule: Badges / status (soft/tinted badges for low-emphasis metadata are neutral gray) + Empty states collapse
findings.evidence: Every one of the 20 collapsed segment rows carries the same tinted chip 'არ არის შევსებული'. The single recorded row (CIV პროქს. · მარცხენა) carries 'შევსებულია' in exactly the same tint, size and weight. The source uses EMRBadge variant="neutral", but it renders light-blue rather than neutral gray. So 'filled' and 'empty' look identical, and the empty state is the louder of the two because it repeats 20 times. That is the 'every card badged' pattern. The rows themselves collapsing to one line is a large win: page height fell from 13,848px to 4,066px.
findings.recommendation: Invert the emphasis. Show nothing on empty rows, or at most a muted gray '—' in --emr-text-secondary, and show a chip only on recorded rows. Also make the neutral EMRBadge variant actually render the neutral-gray soft treatment, fixed once in the wrapper and not per page. Recorded rows then become the only badged items and scan at a glance.
